choice_prompt:2:1522026001.text: Oh, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here too. Looks like I'm not needed after all.
choice_prompt:2:1522026001.source_cn: 喔……<style=stress><player_name></style>大人也在这里。看来未必需要老朽出面啊。
choice_prompt:2:1522026001.male: Oh, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here too. Looks like I'm not needed after all.
choice_prompt:2:1522026001.female: Oh, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here too. Looks like I'm not needed after all.

say:4:1522026003:1.text: Now, can one of you fill me in on what's actually going on?
say:4:1522026003:1.source_cn: 那么，你们几个，谁来说说怎么回事？

say:6:1522026004:1.text: We're trying to catch the Gilded Serpent, a monster summoned by a fallen goddess.
say:6:1522026004:1.source_cn: 我们在抓金鳞蛇皇。那家伙是堕神召唤出来的怪物！

say:7:1522026005:1.text:
Fallen goddess? Monster?
... I can't wrap my head around anything you said.
say:7:1522026005:1.source_cn: 堕神……怪物？\n……你说什么呢，老朽怎么听不明白？

say:8:1522026006:1.text: After Luvo explains everything to Modra, the frown on Modra's face fades away.
say:8:1522026006:1.source_cn: 烈声将抓捕金鳞蛇皇的原因和经过为蒙多讲述了一遍。在他讲...

say:9:1522026007:1.text: ... That three-headed snake has golden scales on its body! It's obviously a monster summoned by the Hunting Goddess!
say:9:1522026007:1.source_cn: ……那蛇长着金黄色的鳞片，还有三个头，很显然就是狩猎神...

say:10:1522026008:1.text: Well, well, well... You young ones are really some hotheaded bunch!
say:10:1522026008:1.source_cn: 唉……你们几个呀，真是太鲁莽！

say:11:1522026009:0.text: Come here and take a look at this.

say:13:1522026010:0.text: Does this golden scale look the same as those on the "Gilded Serpent" you all saw?
say:13:1522026010:0.source_cn: 这金色鳞片，可是和你们看见的“金鳞蛇皇”身上的一样？

say:18:1522026012:1.text: Modra, how did you come by that scale?
say:18:1522026012:1.source_cn: 蒙多，你为什么会有金鳞蛇皇的鳞片？

say:21:1522026013:1.text: The truth is, the "Gilded Serpent" isn't actually a snake, but a fish. We Wildborn once offered it to the <style="highlight">Hunting Goddess as a sacrifice</style> during a ritual.
say:21:1522026013:1.source_cn: 因为你们说的“金鳞蛇皇”，它不是蛇，而是鱼。是雅库伯尔...

say:25:1522026015:1.text: But... how come it has three heads?
say:25:1522026015:1.source_cn: 可是……鱼为什么会有三个头？

say:26:1522026016:1.text: The Hunting Goddess didn't fancy the fish's appearance, so she gave them three heads and golden scales before releasing them into the swamp near her temple. It's a sign of her blessing.
say:26:1522026016:1.source_cn: 狩猎神不喜欢雅库伯尔献给她的鱼的样貌，因此将它们变作金...

say:27:1522026017:1.text: And this scale I hold is a gift the goddess bestowed upon us back then.
say:27:1522026017:1.source_cn: 而这枚鳞片，就是当时狩猎神给予我等的。

say:28:1522026018:1.text: They're still monsters created by the Hunting Goddess, nonetheless!
say:28:1522026018:1.source_cn: 但要这么说的话，它们也还是狩猎神创造的怪物啊！

say:29:1522026019:1.text: Not really. The divine power only altered their appearance, and they're no different from any other fish.
say:29:1522026019:1.source_cn: 不，神力改变的仅仅是它们的外形。除此之外，它们和其他鱼...

say:30:1522026020:1.text: Otherwise, they'd have mutated and attacked the Wildborn when the Hunting Goddess fell.
say:30:1522026020:1.source_cn: 否则，狩猎神神堕时它们早就随之一同异变，袭击雅库伯尔了...

say:34:1522026022:1.text: Gilded Serpent... Not a bad name at all! Let's just call the fish that from now on.
say:34:1522026022:1.source_cn: 金鳞蛇皇……呵呵，这名字起得不错，以后就用它来称呼这些鱼吧。

say:35:1522026023:1.text: With the Hunting Goddess fallen, the Gilded Serpent won't have the power to attack us. There's no reason to worry.
say:35:1522026023:1.source_cn: 狩猎神已经陨落，金鳞蛇皇没有力量袭击雅库伯尔，不必为此担忧。

say:36:1522026024:0.text: Besides, we've got <style="stress"><player_name></style> here. He will make sure nothing bad happens.
say:36:1522026024:0.male: Besides, we've got <style="stress"><player_name></style> here. He will make sure nothing bad happens.
say:36:1522026024:0.female: Besides, we've got <style="stress"><player_name></style> here. She will make sure nothing bad happens.

choice_prompt:38:1522026024.text: Besides, we've got <style="stress"><player_name></style> here. He will make sure nothing bad happens.
choice_prompt:38:1522026024.source_cn: 再说了，还有<style=stress><player_name></style>在。<male>他</male><female>她</female>会阻止不好的事发生。
choice_prompt:38:1522026024.male: Besides, we've got <style="stress"><player_name></style> here. He will make sure nothing bad happens.
choice_prompt:38:1522026024.female: Besides, we've got <style="stress"><player_name></style> here. She will make sure nothing bad happens.

say:40:1522026025:0.text: Anyway, I'm sure the fish still hold some of the divine power! Can't let 'em roam free!
say:40:1522026025:0.source_cn: 就算是这样，金鳞蛇皇身上肯定还有堕神的神力。俺不放心，...

say:42:1522026026:1.text: Exactly... Anything related to the fallen goddess must be destroyed. Think about those warriors who lost their lives to the goddess' beasts!
say:42:1522026026:1.source_cn: 没错……一切和堕神有关的东西都不能留下，不然怎么对得起...

say:46:1522026028:1.text: So what? Remember what it was like before the Hunting Goddess unleashed her beasts on us? We used to hunt wild wolves without fear!
say:46:1522026028:1.source_cn: 那又怎么样？狩猎神指挥兽群袭击我们之前，你会害怕捕猎一...

say:47:1522026029:1.text: Tsk, you just won't get it no matter what I say.

say:48:1522026030:1.text: Hardhammer, let's catch the fish before they harm anyone!
say:48:1522026030:1.source_cn: 坚锤，走，我们继续去抓金鳞蛇皇。绝不能让它伤害任何人！

say:51:1522026031:1.text: Modra, aren't you going to talk some sense into them?

say:52:1522026032:1.text: Well, they're free to do it. It won't anger any gods.
say:52:1522026032:1.source_cn: 那只是几条长相奇特的鱼，要抓就抓，也不会再惹怒哪个神。

say:53:1522026033:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you can try fishing for them too if you're up for it. Those Gilded Serpents live in the <style="highlight">swamp</style> and are most active at <style="highlight">night</style>.
say:53:1522026033:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you can try fishing for them too if you're up for it. Those Gilded Serpents live in the <style="highlight">swamp</style> and are most active at <style="highlight">night</style>.
say:53:1522026033:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you can try fishing for them too if you're up for it. Those Gilded Serpents live in the <style="highlight">swamp</style> and are most active at <style="highlight">night</style>.

say:54:1522026034:1.text: Can't deny, those fish do have a pretty wild look.
say:54:1522026034:1.source_cn: 无论怎么说，它们的模样确实很有趣。
say:54:1522026034:1.male: Can't deny, those fish do have a pretty wild look.
say:54:1522026034:1.female: Can't deny, those fish do have a pretty wild look.

choice:2:0:1.text: You got here just in time.
choice:2:0:1.male: You got here just in time.
choice:2:0:1.female: You got here just in time.
